newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson attacks Great Western rejection.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson attacks Great Western rejection.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said Great Western Financial Corp's rejection of its bid disregarded its shareholders' interests.
"The Great Western Board is obviously afraid of creating a level playing field to assure that the best interests of its stockholders are served," said Ahmanson in a press release.

Great Western, which agreed to merge with Washington Mutual Inc in early March to thwart Ahmanson's hostile bid, formally rejected Ahmanson's latest bid Wednesday and urged shareholders against signing Ahmanson's consent solicitation.
"For the board to reject the Ahmanson merger proposal without ever discussing it with us is inconsistent with maximizing stockholder value," Ahmanson said.

Ahmanson said Great Western's advisors know that if the board publicly indicated a willingness to discuss its proposal, there would be a strong likelihood the marketplace would assign higher certainty and value to Ahmanson's bid.
On March 17, Ahmanson raised its bid by boosting its exchange rate to between 1.10 and 1.20 Ahmanson shares for each Great Western share held.
Ahmanson said it will not be deterred by Great Western's board and is not going away.

Ahmanson said Great Western's actions make it imperative that directors who are truly responsive to the fiduciary duties of shareholders rather than those of Washington Mutual be added to the Great Western board.
Ahmanson also urged Great Western shareholders to participate in its consent solicitation.
